newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl to meet Yeltsin as planned on Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Kohl to meet Yeltsin as planned on Saturday.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin and German Chancellor Helmut Kohl will meet as planned on Saturday despite news that Yeltsin is to have heart surgery this month, government spokesman Peter Hausmann said on Friday.
Hausmann said there had been no changes in the schedule for the meeting outside Moscow which the leaders arranged in a telephone conversation 10 days ago.
Yeltsin said on Thursday he would have heart surgery at the end of September, and on Friday an announcement was made that this would be a bypass operation.
Yeltsin was twice admitted to hospital last year with ischaemic heart disease -- a reduction in the blood supply to the heart usually caused by a clogging of the cardiac arteries.
